title: 去超市
topicEn: Going to the supermarket with mom

explanations.4: 前 is a location noun meaning 'in front of'.
explanations.6: 里 is a location noun meaning 'inside'.
explanations.7: 了 marks completion of an action.
explanations.8: 两 is the number two used before measure words.
explanations.9: 个 is a common measure word for objects.
explanations.11: 杯 is a measure word for cups of liquid.
explanations.12: 块 is a measure word for pieces or chunks.
explanations.13: 多少 is a question word asking for quantity or price.
explanations.14: 很 is a degree adverb meaning 'very'.
explanations.15: 的 is a structural particle indicating possession or modification.
explanations.16: 也 is an adverb meaning 'also' or 'too'.
explanations.17: 本 is a measure word for books.
explanations.18: 那 is a demonstrative pronoun meaning 'that'.
explanations.19: 家 is a measure word for shops or families.
explanations.20: 真 is an adverb meaning 'really' or 'truly'.

translation: Yesterday was Sunday. I went to the supermarket with my mom. The supermarket is in front of the school. We walked from home to the supermarket. There was a lot of fruit inside the supermarket. I bought two apples and a cup of water. Mom bought a piece of cake. How much was it in total? Very expensive. While paying, I discovered I didn't bring money. I also bought two books, but I had no money. The things in that supermarket are really cheap. We all felt it wasn't expensive. Next time we'll come together again.
